news.raw_snippet:
Why this matters: An investor may write 20 term sheets a year, while a founder may see one to three over an entire career. AI can help close that gap by translating legal language into plain terms and preparing sharper questions for counsel.

Illai was clear on the limits: Avoid uploading confidential documents without considering platform terms of service; when possible, share only the specific clauses in question; and treat this as preparation, not a substitute for a startup lawyer.

## TLDR [...] For example, AI can dramatically reduce the time and effort required to identify and prioritize the right investors, addressing the investor data challenge while freeing up human capital. In turn, founders can focus more of their energy on building relationships that strengthen their social capital and ultimately improve their chances of raising financial capital.

Here are the takeaways from the session:

Investor Discovery | Investor Prioritization | Meeting Prep | Due Diligence [...] ## Investor Discovery: How to Find Investors

Investor data can often be out of date, private funds can be invisible to public databases, and it is difficult to scope which investors fit a given startup's thesis and portfolio. With AI, you can create structured prompting to test a startup's thesis against investor fit and generate a targeted, prioritized list, rather than relying on time consuming manual research alone.

news.snippet: Let Healthcare Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbo...
news.raw_snippet: Let Healthcare Dive's free newsletter keep you informed, straight from your inbox. Brian Manning, who previously worked at health tech companies like Bamboo Health and Zocdoc, replaces the AI company’s co-founder and former CEO Alex LeBrun. Manning is joining the artificial intelligence-backed clinical documentation firm as the company looks to scale and snag more healthcare customers, Nabla said in a press release Tuesday. Manning previously worked at Bamboo Health, a health technology company that assists with care coordination, behavioral health capacity and referrals, and controlled substance monitoring and analytics. He also served as chief revenue officer of care coordination tech firm PatientPing, which was acquired by Bamboo in 2021, and worked at doctor search company Zocdoc, according to his LinkedIn. He joins as Nabla aims to expand its reach in the competitive AI scribe space. The company works with more than 190 healthcare organizations, including CVS Health, M Health Fairview and UCLA Health, according to the release.
